name: Thin Films, Coatings & Surface Engineering
summary: Covers depositing and engineering thin films and coatings, from semiconductor layers to wear-resistant and thermal-barrier coatings.

topics.name: Physical vapour deposition: evaporation, sputtering and pulsed laser deposition
Chemical vapour deposition and plasma-enhanced CVD
Epitaxial growth and film growth modes (Frank-van der Merwe, Volmer-Weber, Stranski-Krastanov)
Nucleation and microstructure of films: structure-zone models
Stress in thin films: Stoney equation, wafer curvature and delamination
Thermal spray: plasma spray, HVOF and cold spray
Hard and wear-resistant coatings: TiN, DLC and diamond
Surface modification: ion implantation, shot peening and laser surface treatment
Measuring film thickness, adhesion and properties
